stops.name: Wendelstein
stops.detail: The mountain is calling louder than ever: since Covid, outdoor sports are booming, the Alps are literally overrun. Especially around the so-called Munich local mountains between Wendelstein and Tegernsee, things are getting tight. “It is all the more important that we are also prepared to make compromises, to show consideration for nature and animals, so that we can preserve this unique ecosystem,” Antonia thinks.
